state_and_ABI_limits.mode: Physical x86-32 interpretation has no prefixes and uses 32-bit operands. Actual code/segment attributes, mappings, permissions and live registers/memory remain unestablished.
state_and_ABI_limits.stack: Require current SS.B=1 separately at every PUSH, POP and near CALL for ESP-based stack arithmetic modulo 2^32. That predicate is renewed at each instruction and after each opaque call. Current SS.B=0 instead uses SP. Explicit MOV EBP,ESP itself needs no stack-address-size predicate.
state_and_ABI_limits.entry: On uninterrupted normal completion before the first opaque call, PUSH EBP stores current EBP and MOV EBP,ESP copies current ESP. PUSH [0109DD64] reads a dword through current DS and stores it through current SS. No cell value, linear address, flat-segment equality, readability or writability is established.
state_and_ABI_limits.calls: BF66F8 encodes CALL C04FDE with signed rel32 +59617 and next/encoded return BF66FD. BF6707 encodes CALL C04EF3 with signed rel32 +59367 and next/encoded return BF670C. Each callee is opaque here. At a potential returned continuation, register, stack, flag and segment state are unknown; no caller/callee-saved or stack-preservation guarantee is imported.
state_and_ABI_limits.condition: TEST EAX,EAX reads the current returned EAX, writes ZF/SF/PF, clears CF/OF and leaves AF undefined. Under uninterrupted normal TEST-POP ECX-JZ composition, POP does not change EAX or EFLAGS, so JZ reaches BF6705 exactly when that current EAX is zero. This supplies no EAX meaning or validity.
state_and_ABI_limits.nonzero_branch: Otherwise POP EBP reads current SS stack state and JMP EAX uses the then-current EAX as an indirect code offset. The POP preserves EAX on normal completion. No executable target, signature, argument interpretation, callback identity, frame restoration or tail-call contract is established.
state_and_ABI_limits.zero_branch: BF6705 pushes the literal 2, then the second opaque CALL may return. Subsequent POP ECX and POP EBP consume current stack values under newly required current SS.B=1. Their values are not identified as earlier pushes or the original caller registers.
state_and_ABI_limits.final_jump: BF670E is E9 A8 FE FF FF: signed rel32 -344, numeric next BF6713 and target BF65BB. It encodes a direct near JMP with no CALL return-slot push. Saved override CALL_RETURN changes default UNCONDITIONAL_JUMP to effective CALL_TERMINATOR only in metadata; its companion no_return=true and name do not prove target behavior.
state_and_ABI_limits.identity: Owner and companion names, no-return/thunk flags and previous descriptive labels remain saved identity metadata. No library/provider, prototype, service meaning, original ABI, aggregate stack balance or actual runtime traversal is established.
state_and_ABI_limits.exceptions: Normal-completion instruction statements exclude faults, interrupts and exceptional transitions. No aggregate postcondition crosses either opaque callee.
state_and_ABI_limits.stop: BF6713 and every external numeric target, cell, provider and prototype remain unqueried.
